name: March
title: Where to go on holiday in March
intro: March is a month of in-betweens: winter sun is still going strong, the ski season has its sunniest weeks, and spring starts in places like Marrakech and Tokyo.
seo_title: Where is hot in March? Spring sun and where to go

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
March is when winter sun starts to feel like spring sun. The Canary Islands, Cape Verde and Marrakech are all in the low to mid twenties, and southern Spain warms up fast: Seville often reaches 22°C by the end of the month. The rest of the Mediterranean is mild, in the mid to high teens, which is good weather for walking and city breaks but not yet for the beach.

For heat, 28°C and above, you still need a long-haul flight. March is the end of the dry season in much of the Caribbean, Mexico and Southeast Asia, so it's one of the last good months for them before the rains and the summer heat.

The temperatures below are average daytime highs for March, rounded. Flight times are typical direct flights from London. Everywhere at its best in March is listed above.

sections.heading: The ranking at a glance
sections.text:
The warmest places within about six hours of the UK:

- **1. Luxor and the [Nile](/destinations/nile-cruise):** around 29°C, getting hotter by the week. About 5 hours.
- **2. [Cape Verde](/destinations/cape-verde):** around 25°C and sunny. About 6 hours.
- **3. [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife), [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria) and [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote):** around 23°C. About 4 hours.
- **4. [Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech):** around 23°C by day, with cooler nights. About 3 hours 30 minutes.
- **5. [Seville](/destinations/seville):** around 22°C, with orange blossom in the streets. About 2 hours 30 minutes.
- **6. [Málaga](/destinations/malaga) and [Essaouira](/destinations/essaouira):** around 20°C. About 2 hours 45 minutes to Málaga.
- **7. [Madeira](/destinations/madeira), [Lisbon](/destinations/lisbon), the [Algarve](/destinations/algarve) and [Paphos](/destinations/paphos):** around 19°C. 2 hours 45 minutes to 4 hours 30 minutes.
- **8. [Malta](/destinations/malta), [Athens](/destinations/athens) and [Sicily](/destinations/syracuse):** around 17°C. About 3 to 3 hours 30 minutes.

sections.heading: Spring sun under five hours
sections.text:
The Canaries are still the surest sunshine in Europe, a degree or so warmer than in January, and the sea is around 18 to 19°C. Fuerteventura and Lanzarote are the driest; the south of Tenerife and Gran Canaria the warmest.

March is also one of the best months for [Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech): warm, sunny days without the summer heat, though the evenings are still cool enough for a jumper. A [desert road trip](/destinations/morocco-desert-road-trip) over the Atlas Mountains is easier now than at any other time of year.

If you'd rather not fly so far, southern Spain is the pick. [Seville](/destinations/seville) is at its best before the heat, and [Málaga](/destinations/malaga) and [Cádiz](/destinations/cadiz) are pleasant for walking and eating outside. Our [Spain holiday page](/destinations/holidays-in-spain) has more.

sections.heading: Spring city breaks
sections.text:
March is a good month for a European city break: prices are still low, queues are short, and it's mild enough to walk all day. [Lisbon](/destinations/lisbon) and [Porto](/destinations/porto) are around 17 to 19°C, [Rome](/destinations/rome) and [Florence](/destinations/florence) around 16°C, and [Barcelona](/destinations/barcelona) and [Madrid](/destinations/madrid) around 16 to 17°C. [Valencia](/destinations/valencia) holds its Fallas festival in mid-March, with huge sculptures, fireworks and bonfires, but it gets very busy and hotels fill early.

Further north, [Paris](/destinations/paris), [Amsterdam](/destinations/amsterdam) and [Budapest](/destinations/budapest) are still chilly, around 10 to 12°C, but cheaper than they'll be all spring. See our [city breaks](/destinations/city-breaks) page for the full list.

sections.heading: Sunny skiing and the last of the northern lights
sections.text:
March brings longer, sunnier days on the slopes, and snow is usually still good at altitude. [Val Thorens](/destinations/val-thorens), [Zermatt](/destinations/zermatt), [Verbier](/destinations/verbier), [St Anton](/destinations/st-anton) and [Chamonix](/destinations/chamonix) are all at their best, and if Easter falls early it can be cheaper than February half term. See our [ski holidays](/destinations/ski-holidays) page.

In the Arctic, the nights are getting shorter but are still dark enough for the northern lights, and the extra daylight makes husky and snowmobile trips more pleasant. [Tromsø](/destinations/tromso), [Kiruna](/destinations/kiruna), [Rovaniemi](/destinations/rovaniemi) and [Levi](/destinations/levi) are all good, and the spring equinox is traditionally a strong time for aurora activity.

sections.heading: Long-haul: the last of the dry season
sections.text:
March is one of the last reliable months for many long-haul favourites.

- **The Caribbean:** [Barbados](/destinations/barbados), [Antigua](/destinations/antigua), [St Lucia](/destinations/st-lucia) and [Grenada](/destinations/grenada) are around 29 to 30°C and dry.
- **Mexico:** [Cancún](/destinations/cancun), [Bacalar](/destinations/bacalar) and [Mexico City](/destinations/mexico-city) are warm and dry, and [Oaxaca](/destinations/oaxaca) is at its hottest.
- **Asia:** [Phuket](/destinations/phuket), [Koh Lanta](/destinations/koh-lanta), [Langkawi](/destinations/langkawi), [Sri Lanka](/destinations/sri-lanka) and the [Maldives](/destinations/maldives) are 31 to 34°C, hot and humid. [Hoi An](/destinations/hoi-an) is warming up nicely.
- **The Gulf:** [Dubai](/destinations/dubai) and [Oman](/destinations/oman) are around 28 to 29°C, the last comfortable month before summer.
- **Japan:** [Tokyo](/destinations/tokyo)'s cherry blossom usually starts in late March, though it moves a little each year.

sections.heading: How to choose
sections.text:
If you want guaranteed warmth within a short flight, go to the Canaries or Marrakech. If mild and sunny is enough, southern Spain and Portugal give you more for less time in the air, and the cities are lovely before the crowds. For a last week of proper heat before the spring, the Caribbean and Thailand are still in season.

If you're choosing as a family or group and can't agree, put a few of these on a shortlist and let everyone vote with points. That's what somewhere🎉 is for, and our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday) explains how it works.

faqs.question: Where is warm in March?
faqs.answer: Further away, the Caribbean, Mexico, the Maldives and Sri Lanka are still in their dry season. Closer to the UK, Tenerife, Cape Verde and Marrakech are warm, though Marrakech's evenings are still cool.

faqs.question: When is cherry blossom in Tokyo?
faqs.answer: Usually from late March to early April, but it changes a little each year, so check the forecasts nearer the time. It's Tokyo's busiest season, so book well ahead.

faqs.question: Is March good for skiing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Chamonix and Whistler have long, sunny days and plenty of snow, and Easter is often cheaper than February half term if it falls early.

faqs.question: Where is the hottest place in Europe in March?
faqs.answer: The Canary Islands, with average March highs of around 23°C. Seville is close behind by the end of the month, at around 22°C.

faqs.question: Is Spain warm in March?
faqs.answer: Southern Spain is warm and often sunny, with Seville around 22°C and Málaga around 20°C. Madrid and Barcelona are milder, around 16 to 17°C.

faqs.question: Where is hot in March with a short flight?
faqs.answer: Marrakech and the Canary Islands, at about three and a half to four hours, are around 23°C. Seville and Málaga are under three hours away and around 20 to 22°C.
